pages.text: A $(item)power switch$() sits on a power wire and changes what is wired to what. $(thing)Right click$() throws its lever, and so does a $(thing)redstone pulse$(): once, as the signal comes on. It stays where it is while the signal stays on.$(br2)Place it facing you. The side towards you is its main terminal.

pages.title: On/Off
pages.text: Wire in on the side facing you and out of the side opposite. $(thing)On$(), the two wires are one circuit; $(thing)off$(), they are two.$(br2)Put one between the batteries and a radio to switch the radio off without breaking a wire.

pages.title: Left/Right
pages.text: The input is the side facing you, with an output on its left and its right. The lever joins the input to the $(thing)left$() or the $(thing)right$() output; the other one is a circuit of its own.$(br2)Use it to move a radio from one battery bank to another.
